details: MLOps & Deployment Experience

• Experiment Tracking: MLflow and SageMaker Experiments for hyperparameter and model tracking.
• Model Registry & Deployment: SageMaker Model Registry, Lambda triggers, ECR for containerized models, serverless endpoints
for cost efficiency.
• Monitoring & Retraining: Model Monitor, Prometheus, CloudWatch, event-driven retraining using Lambda and S3 triggers.
• CI/CD: GitHub Actions for automated build, test, and deployment pipelines; integrated with AWS CLI/SDK.
• Security & Networking: IAM roles, VPC, security groups, private subnets for secure and scalable deployments.
